notes: 1.0.0 is the published baseline; this target curates five post-1.0.0 security/release fixes for a synchronized 1.0.1 cut.
The five fixes are: direct-plan policy enforcement, scope-denial redaction, viewer-specific cache control, HTTP method case matching, and phased-release candidate hash/commit pinning.
Local repository checks can be recorded on this branch; maintainer review, protected-environment approval and publication verification remain pending.
